style: Clean colouring-book line art for a printed German study book: bold, even black outlines on pure white, every shape left completely white inside so it can be coloured in with pencils, no colour, no grey, no shading, no hatching, no gradients. Friendly picture-book drawing with simple shapes and large areas to colour. Generous white margins, nothing touches the edges. No text, no letters, no numbers.
